gaps.explanation: Detail has only the General Fund combining schedule (p10, Total revenues 668,356). The governmental funds statement (p5) also prints Street and Debt Service columns, which have no schedule of their own and are not in detail. Street: Taxes 24,698 + Intergovernmental 85,909 = 110,607; Debt Service: Taxes 70,099 + Intergovernmental 19,429 + Interest 1,809 + Miscellaneous 5,718 = 97,055. 110,607 + 97,055 = 207,662 = gap. Check: 668,356 + 207,662 = 876,018 = statement Totals revenues (p5). Categories follow the statement lines for the same cells (Street Taxes = franchise fees, Debt Service Taxes = property tax levied for debt service, Statement of Activities p3).

gaps.explanation: Schedule 273,982 vs statement 118 (schedule above by 273,864). Detail index 38 (General Fund - General, printed 'Transfers' (273,982), p10; note it is labelled 'Transfers In' in detail although the amount is an outflow) is the only transfer out in detail. The General Fund combining schedule (p10) prints department transfers General (273,982), Community Building 22,446, Police 6,062, Fire 27,954, Park 177,277, Totals (40,243); the statement (p5) prints General (40,243), Street 10,000, Debt Service 30,125, Totals (118) on one net 'Transfers in (out)' row, so the statement total is net of all governmental interfund transfers. Gross (detail) vs net (statement) presentation; this is the whole 273,864 (273,982 - 118). The Street 10,000 and Debt Service 30,125 transfers in printed in the missing statement columns (p5) are added here (they are transfers in; the report has no transfers_in gap row because the statement total is a net outflow).

gaps.explanation: Schedule 4,119,143 vs statement 357,206 (schedule above by 3,761,937). Detail index 60 'Nursing Home revenues' 3,761,937 is from the Combined Schedule ... Budget and Actual - All Fund Types (p9, Total revenues 4,995,161), marked outside_statement. The nursing home (Park View) is not a fund in the basic statements; the proprietary statement (p8) prints Total operating revenues 357,206 (Sewer 87,754, Ambulance 55,904, Water 166,354, Sanitation 47,194), which the other business-type detail lines (indexes 44-48) equal exactly. 357,206 + 3,761,937 = 4,119,143. Scope difference; no detail fix.

Schedule 4,019,363 vs statement 350,797 (schedule above by 3,668,566) has two parts. (1) Missing lines: detail has only the operating expense lines of the proprietary statement (p8, total operating expenses 259,197), not the nonoperating expenses printed in the Sewer and Water columns: Capital expenses Sewer (22,000), Water (25,387); Debt service Principal Sewer (3,080), Water (27,551); Interest Sewer (509), Water (13,073); total (91,600) (p8; statement business-type disbursements 350,797 = 259,197 + 91,600, Statement of Activities p2). Added below as positive expenditure lines, as the statement lines and FY2023 detail record them. (2) Different basis: detail index 61 'Public buildings - nursing home' 3,760,166 is from the p9 all-fund budget schedule (outside_statement); the nursing home is not in the basic statements. Arithmetic: 4,019,363 + 91,600 = 4,110,963; 4,110,963 - 350,797 = 3,760,166 = the nursing home line, which stays as a scope difference. Gap is therefore not fully closed by design.
